title: Foundereum
tagline: Foundereum: A business account and metered toolbelt for AI agents, settled on Hedera.
description: Give an AI agent (Claude Code, any MCP client or your AI Pipeline) a Privy secured wallet, a spending policy, and an x402 API key. Every tool it uses, swapping tokens, transferring funds, or pulling live on-chain data from The Graph, is paid for automatically with a sub-cent HTS payment via Blocky402, inside limits your team sets and can audit on HCS. No subscriptions, no shared API keys, no unbounded agent access to your treasury.
how_its_made:
Foundereum is built in Go (API, Gateway, MCP server, Asynq worker) and React + TypeScript, backed by PostgreSQL  (double-entry ledger) and Redis (rate limits, nonces).

AI agents connect via Model Context Protocol (MCP). Every tool call is metered through HTTP 402: the gateway issues a cryptographic challenge, the agent’s wallet signs the payment, and tools execute only upon verified on-chain settlement.


Partner Tech:

• Hedera: Sub-cent HTS USDC micropayments and public auditability. Every settled call is committed to a Hedera Consensus Service (HCS) topic (0.0.10442234) verifiable on HashScan.

• Privy: Provisions split Treasury and Agent server wallets in TEE enclaves. Spending limits and allowlists are enforced at the hardware level (default_action: DENY), with WebCrypto multi-sig quorums for withdrawals

• The Graph: Powers our agent data tools via Messari standardized subgraphs for live, cross-chain DEX pool intelligence.

Notable Hack:
A zero-key automated x402 loop: the LLM never touches private keys or handles payment math. The gateway determines pricing from arguments, requests a TEE signature, settles atomically via Redis GETDEL (preventing replays), and returns verified data transparently.
auto_summary: A Go and React platform that meters AI agent tool calls and settles per-call payments using Hedera, Privy-managed wallets, and Graph-backed data tools.
